tools.name: company_profile
tools.description: Research a company from its website: name, description, socials, emails, key pages, pricing mentions, tech stack.

tools.name: site_audit
tools.description: Audit a web page: SEO, performance hints, security headers, broken internal links; returns score 0-100 and issues.

tools.name: page_to_json
tools.description: Fetch a web page and return structured JSON: meta, Open Graph, JSON-LD, headings, links, images, clean text.

tools.name: email_check
tools.description: Validate an email address or domain via live DNS: syntax, MX/null-MX, SPF, DMARC policy, disposable/free/role flags, deliverability verdict and 0-100 score. No SMTP probe.

tools.name: sitemap_urls
tools.description: List a site's URLs from its sitemaps (robots.txt Sitemap: lines, nested indexes, text sitemaps) with lastmod/changefreq/priority; optional since date filter.

tools.name: page_diff
tools.description: Monitor a page for changes: returns normalized text + SHA-256 content_hash; pass previous_text (or previous_hash) from an earlier call to get changed flag and added/removed lines.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: page_to_json, email_check, sitemap_urls · Public sink: email_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: page_to_json, email_check, sitemap_urls · Public sink: email_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
